parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with a narrow QRS and a marked left axis deviation (tall R in I and aVL, rS in II, III and aVF), which is consistent with left anterior fascicular block. There is no bundle branch block, pre-excitation, AV block or infarct pattern, and the mild ST elevation in V2–V3 is the usual concave, early-repolarization type, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
